headline: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash hits all-time high; Stealth stumbles
summary: Google's gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 just set an all-time token-share record at 6.4%, day 2 of its climb—meanwhile stealth/ox-alpha shed 8.9 percentage points despite holding the top spot. DeepSeek consolidated gains across its lineup, now commanding 20.1% of the market, while Zhipu AI surged 3.0 points on the strength of a fresh GLM 5.3 Flash entry.
highlights: Google's gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 reaches 6.4% token share (all-time high, day 2 of streak)
stealth/ox-alpha drops 8.9 points to 21.7% but remains #1
DeepSeek climbs to 20.1% market share (+3.4 points in one day)
Zhipu AI jumps 3.0 points; new GLM 5.3 Flash model debuts at rank 11 with 2.0% share
MiniMax's free tier hits all-time high at 0.7%; five new models entered top 51
Five models dropped out; Google and OpenAI each saw churn in their rosters
